public class MyEventsActivity extends androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
Activity that displays the current user's events.

This screen is divided into two top-level tabs:

  • Registered - events the user has registered for, grouped by status
  • Hosting - events the user is organizing, grouped by progress

The activity loads event data, classifies events into sections, and updates the UI accordingly. It also provides navigation to other app screens such as explore, saved, profile, scan, event details, and event creation.

    • loadRegisteredEvents

      private void loadRegisteredEvents()
      Loads all events the current user has registered for.

      If the request succeeds, the events are bound to the registered sections. If it fails, an error state is shown as long as the registered tab is still active.

    • loadHostedEvents

      private void loadHostedEvents()
      Loads all events hosted by the current user from Firestore.

      If an event is missing its event ID, the Firestore document ID is assigned to it. Results are only displayed if the hosting tab is still active.

    • isSelected

      private boolean isSelected(Event event)
      Determines whether the current user has been selected or enrolled in an event.

      A user is considered selected if their device ID appears in the enrolled list, chosen list, or waiting list chosen list.

      Parameters:
      event - the event to check
      Returns:
      true if the current user is selected; false otherwise

    • isWaiting

      private boolean isWaiting(Event event)
      Determines whether the event should be shown in the waiting section.

      An event is considered waiting if the registration deadline has not passed yet, or if the deadline has passed but selection results have not yet been published.

      Parameters:
      event - the event to evaluate
      Returns:
      true if the event is still waiting for selection results; false otherwise

    • shouldUsePrimaryImage

      private boolean shouldUsePrimaryImage(Event event)
      Chooses which placeholder image background to use for an event card.

      The selection is based on the hash of the event category to provide a consistent but varied appearance across cards.

      Parameters:
      event - the event whose category is used for image selection
      Returns:
      true if the primary image should be used; false if the secondary image should be used
